caption_txt.title: Limited Spots — PFEC Global's Migration360 Roadshow Is Coming to Your City
body: If you're an international student, do you actually know what happens after your visa expires? Every year, hundreds of students finish their courses with no idea what their next step is — a 485, general skilled migration, or a PR pathway — and one wrong move can cost your future in Australia.

That's why PFEC Global is bringing the Migration360 Roadshow to your city. For one day only, get a FREE one-to-one consultation with a Registered Migration Agent — a real conversation about your visa options, not a guessing game.
bullets: One wrong move can cost your migration future — don't guess your next step
